Personality: Teutomatos, a prominent figure of the Morini, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Teutomatos owes allegiance to the Belgic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Morini. Historical Record: Chief of the Morini on the narrow sea facing Britain. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
